items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 1037-1040: under excluded middle, a relation is well-founded exactly when every nonempty subset merely has a minimal element. The proof (source lines 1041-1057) is carried out in full in both directions and its substance is not visible in the statement: the first direction introduces an auxiliary claim that no accessible element lies in a subset with no minimal element and establishes it by induction on the accessibility witness, using the merely existing smaller element together with access to the induction hypothesis at that element; the second direction forms the subset of non-accessible elements, applies the minimal-element hypothesis to it, and closes the argument by excluded middle together with induction on truncation, which is the step that turns mere accessibility into accessibility. Two directions, an auxiliary induction and a truncation induction are the substance of the card.
